frozenQuestion: Are sorting from random disorder and recovery after injury to an achieved or partial pattern operationally distinct tasks?

taskFamilies.startState: outcome-blind random disorder with strictly positive target distance
taskFamilies.successRule: reach exact target distance zero within the development opportunity budget

taskFamilies.startState: post-injury state derived from a previously achieved and stabilized target
taskFamilies.preInjuryRequirement: target distance zero plus an absorbing-state and scheduler-coverage stabilization certificate
taskFamilies.secondaryTarget: retain the restored target through the declared observation boundary
taskFamilies.successRule: return to exact target distance zero within the phase-local recovery opportunity budget

taskFamilies.startState: post-injury state derived from an endogenous active checkpoint at first crossing of 50 percent inversion progress
taskFamilies.preInjuryRequirement: strictly positive pre-injury target distance below the initial random-disorder distance
taskFamilies.injuryOnset: atomic checkpoint immediately after the first 50 percent progress crossing
taskFamilies.primaryTarget: regain or improve the pre-injury strict-inversion distance
taskFamilies.successRule: regain checkpoint quality and reach the final target within the phase-local recovery opportunity budget

eventBudget.terminalHandling: budget exhaustion is failure for success and right censoring for time; quiescence is a competing failure
eventBudget.ledgerRule: pre-injury, stabilization, injury, and recovery costs are retained separately and also summed; no phase cost is discarded

stabilization.achievedRule: target distance zero, no admissible occupancy-changing action, and complete post-target actor coverage without an accepted movement
stabilization.uniformCoverageRule: at least two opportunities per identity
stabilization.partialRule: no quiescent stabilization is imposed; the active checkpoint is captured atomically with state and internal-memory hashes

controls: matched no-injury continuation from the identical pre-injury checkpoint
development from the paired original random-disorder scenario
future permanent-fault and spontaneous-recovery controls remain reserved for S04-S05
claimBoundary: Repair and regeneration are operational simulator tasks only; success does not establish active biological repair, biological memory, learning, or causal mechanism outside the declared computational intervention.
